# Final Plan — Olam Current-Production Closure

1. Refresh `origin/main` and prove Better V2 ancestry plus exact eight-path deltas.
2. Inventory current Olam routes, browser callers, asset/update modules, and tests.
3. Run current deterministic suites and targeted API/media tests.
4. If coverage gaps exist, rewrite only the smallest coherent whole files and tests, then reread them fully.
5. Run a real Chrome image lifecycle test: add → attach → replace same ID → preview changes → reload persists → payload uses updated bytes → remove clears payload.
6. Run public production Better V2/intuitive/future-HUD/Director/legacy browser suites on the current production head.
7. Probe safe public API paths and server missing-key/error behavior.
8. Verify production Git HEAD, clean status, and service active.
9. Compare PLANNED vs ACTUAL, resolve any delta, clean owned temporary artifacts, and write final evidence.
10. If production MiniMax remains unconfigured, leave only the paid upstream success path as an explicit external credential boundary.
